final_rationale: The Actor's response improves precision by abandoning any clean-certification theory and narrowing the supportable position to certification with an explicit warehouse-robotics caveat. That is a reinterpretation of the same admissible summary, not new evidence. On the present record, this narrowing is not enough to reach compliant_with_caveats because the caveat itself remains an unresolved compliance predicate: the available evidence still does not include the actual release artifact or model-card text proving that the material limitation is explicitly disclosed, nor an approved mitigation or risk acceptance that would substitute for that disclosure. The response therefore resolves an overbroad claim but does not cure the underlying evidentiary gap.
